description.en: LADBench evaluates large vision-language models on detecting logical anomalies in synthetic images across four domains: Residential, Urban, Collaborative, and Nature. It uses a Tiered Prompting Protocol with three progressive disclosure levels and automated scoring.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing anomaly benchmarks focus on visual errors, not the physical and social common sense required for open-world deployment. LADBench quantifies how much explicit assistance models need to localize and reason about logical faults, addressing a gap in evaluating sequential multimodal reasoning.
